WSP's own FY2025 results release states 'Cash inflows from operating activities' of $2,246.0 million and, within its own free-cash-flow reconciliation, 'net capital expenditures' of $147.2 million for the twelve months ended December 31, 2025. (2,246.0 - 147.2) / 18,285.0 = 0.114783, carried here as 0.1147826, applying the OCF-less-capex convention this canonical field uses (the same convention the yfinance-statements vendor block applied with a slightly different capex figure of $152.9 million, previously 0.11447).
